messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call: Medicore — private hosting deep dive & next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the architecture review with your infra/security teams: 

Recap
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem options) for storing and serving PHI at low latency for Medicore's telehealth workflow.
- Primary non-functional asks you mentioned: SOC2 evidence, private networking (VPC peering or dedicated interconnect), and ability to host on-prem GPU nodes for inference.
- Stakeholders: Sarah (Cloud Ops), Tom (Network), and a security reviewer TBD.

Open items before the arch review
- Medicore to share a high-level network diagram (VPCs, firewall zones, expected egress patterns). I attached a small Network Diagram template that should speed this up.
- Confirm the compliance SME who will attend the call (we'd like someone who can sign off on the data flow).

Proposed architecture review (technical deep dive) 
- Purpose: Walk through deployment model options (VPC peering, private hosting, on-prem appliance), typical runbooks, required firewall rules, and a short checklist for provisioning.
- Duration: 60 minutes (45 min presentation + 15 min Q&A)
- Suggested attendees: Sarah, Tom, your security lead, 2 of your infra engineers, and from our side: Marissa (CS lead), Connor (Solutions Engineer), and me.

Available slots (all PT):
- Wed May 10 — 09:00–10:00 / 14:00–15:00
- Thu May 11 — 11:00–12:00 / 16:00–17:00

If none of these work, send 2 windows that work for your team and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Pre-call artifacts I will share
- SOC2-Summary.pdf (brief evidentiary summary) — attached
- Redwood Private one-pager + deployment options slide deck — will share link once I finish a small customization for Medicore

Next immediate asks
1) Please confirm which slot you prefer (or propose alternatives).
2) Upload a one-page network diagram to the Drive link above or reply inline.
3) Confirm which Medicore attendees will be on the call (need at least one security/ops contact).

Thanks — I’ll wait to send a calendar invite until we lock a time.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142
